'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male student in the photography club, seen with a student from the Department of Exostrider Engineering, '''Lianna'''. They appear at the Academy Gardens during the day. 

He expresses concern about a particular footage lacking light despite the scene was properly well lit.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lianna:''' Location scouting is all about the light. Look at this footage of yours... Where's the light? As it is now, isn't it underexposed? 
:'''Dole:''' Y-Yes, you're right... b-but something's not right!
:'''Dole:''' I even switched on a big light to fill in the scene, but in this footage... there's no light at all...
:'''Dole:''' Why though? This shouldn't be happening...
:'''Dole:''' I can't shake the feeling that something has swallowed up all the light...
{{Dialogue End}}
